credentials.schemaDescription: This schema represents the claim set of an SD-JWT based Verifiable Credential for the eInvoice attestation as a single, flat JSON object. It is based on UBL attributes and aligned with the IETF SD-JWT VC data model: generic SD-JWT VC claims (iss, sub, vct, iat, nbf, exp, jti, cnf) are defined alongside the domain-specific LPID claims. Implementations may conceptually treat this as a layered model (base + domain), but the structure is flat for systems that expect a single JSON Schema document, such as current organizational wallet templates.

attributes.name: vct
attributes.description: The Verifiable Credential Type (VCT) that identifies this ISCC Certification Body credential. Required. Example: urn:org:iscc.iscc-cb:1

attributes.name: cbName
attributes.description: The official name of the ISCC Certification Body (CB). Required. Example: DEKRA Certification B.V.

attributes.name: cbId
attributes.description: The ISCC-internal Certification Body identifier or another stable ID used by ISCC to reference this CB. Required. Example: ISCC-CB-220

attributes.name: legalPersonId
attributes.description: The official registration identifier of the Certification Body, such as EUID, VAT number, or Chamber of Commerce number. Optional. Example: NL123456789B01

attributes.name: isccSchemes
attributes.description: The ISCC schemes for which this Certification Body is officially recognised. Required. Typical values include: ISCC EU, ISCC PLUS, ISCC CORSIA.

attributes.name: recognitionStatus
attributes.description: The current ISCC recognition status of the Certification Body. Required. Example: active

attributes.name: recognitionDate
attributes.description: The date on which the Certification Body was first recognised by ISCC for the relevant schemes. Required. ISO 8601 date format (YYYY-MM-DD). Example: 2024-05-20

attributes.name: recognitionExpiry
attributes.description: The expiry date of the current ISCC recognition, if applicable. ISO 8601 date format (YYYY-MM-DD). Example: 2027-05-20

attributes.name: regions
attributes.description: The regions and/or countries in which this Certification Body is allowed to perform ISCC audits. Values can be regional labels (e.g. EU, Europe, Global) or ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country codes (e.g. NL, DE). Optional.

attributes.name: scopes
attributes.description: The audit scopes for which this Certification Body is recognised under ISCC (for example, traceability, waste & residues, GHG verification, RFNBO/SAF). Optional.

attributes.name: officialWebsite
attributes.description: The official website of the Certification Body. Optional. Example: https://www.dekra-certification.nl

attributes.name: certificateLookup
attributes.description: A public URL where ISCC certificates or audit information for this CB or its clients can be looked up. Optional. Example: https://certificates.iscc-system.org

attributes.description: Verifiable Credential Type claim as defined in SD-JWT. MUST be 'mandate.checkout'.

credentials.shortDescription: Accreditation of an organization as an Authorized Repairer of the Vesta Repair Network (demo). Issued by Vesta's regional subsidiaries and published on the repairer's DID as a Linked Verifiable Presentation, so a household's wallet can verify at the door that a technician's badge chains to a company authorized by the manufacturer. Part of the Verana Playground; for demonstration only.

The reusable retail KYC credential of the Crypto Exchange Association (demo), governed on both sides: issuance and verification each require an accreditation from the association. A customer completes one full identity check at any member exchange or bank and reuses the resulting credential to onboard at every other CEXA member, with the original issuer paid on every reuse. Also issued as AnonCreds over DIDComm with identical claims. Part of the Verana Playground; for demonstration only.

The Travel Rule counterparty identity of a member of the Crypto Exchange Association (demo). Issued exclusively by the Association at member validation and renewal, published on the member's DID as a Linked Verifiable Presentation, and free to verify: any compliance team can resolve a counterparty VASP's DID and check membership, license and compliance contact without contacting the Association. Revoked on license loss. Part of the Verana Playground; for demonstration only.

The single credential of the Playground Ecosystem (demo), issued instantly to visitors of the personal-wallets demo to show the Verifiable Trust model end to end: an accredited issuer whose offer succeeds, a trusted but unaccredited issuer whose offer must be refused by the wallet, and an untrusted issuer that compliant wallets reject before any data is exchanged. Also issued as AnonCreds over DIDComm. Part of the Verana Playground; for demonstration only.
Identifies a human behind a Verifiable Service, such as an employee or member of the operating organization; the issuer identifies the organization or persona the holder represents.
Identifies the legal organization that operates one or more Verifiable Services. Presented as a Linked Verifiable Presentation in the operator's DID Document.
Identifies a Persona, a human-controlled avatar that operates one or more Verifiable Services. Presented as a Linked Verifiable Presentation in the Persona's DID Document.
Identifies a Verifiable Service and defines the minimum trust and access requirements required to interact with it. Presented as a Linked Verifiable Presentation in the service's DID Document.
Identifies a User Agent instance and the software version it runs; the issuer identifies the software product line. Presented unlinkably (zero-knowledge proof) when connecting to Verifiable Services.

ISO 9001-style quality management certification (demo). Issued by an accredited certification body under the ISO Certification (demo) registry of the Verana Playground and published on the certified organization's DID as a Linked Verifiable Presentation; anyone verifies it free of charge through trust resolution. For demonstration only; not affiliated with ISO.

The national identity credential of the Republic of Verandia (demo), a fictional e-government scenario of the Verana Playground. Issued solely by the National Civil Registry with eIDAS-2-PID-inspired claims; verification is governed too: only registered relying parties hold a VERIFIER permission, and compliant wallets refuse requests from anyone else before any attribute leaves the device. For demonstration only.

Proof of legal representation issued by the National Business Registry of the Republic of Verandia (demo): who may act on behalf of a registered company, and with which powers. Issuance is sovereign (the register is the single source of truth); verification is open and free so the whole economy can rely on it. Part of the Verana Playground; for demonstration only.
Buyer pre-approval of a supplier for Peppol eInvoicing (WE BUILD SC5).

attributes.description: Not Before — Unix timestamp before which the credential MUST NOT be accepted. Optional. NOT selectively disclosable.

attributes.name: sub

attributes.name: attestation_legal_category

attributes.name: schema_version

attributes.name: trust_anchor_url

attributes.name: cryptographically_bound_to

attributes.name: approving_party

attributes.name: approving_party/legal_name

attributes.name: approving_party/legal_id

attributes.name: approving_party/peppol_id

attributes.name: approved_supplier
attributes.description: The Supplier (Peppol corner C1) being approved — the holder/subject. Mandatory. MAY be selectively disclosable.

attributes.name: approved_supplier/legal_name
attributes.description: Registered legal name of the approved Supplier.

attributes.name: approved_supplier/legal_id
attributes.description: Unique legal-person identifier (EUID) of the Supplier, sourced from the Supplier's EBWOID.

attributes.name: approved_supplier/peppol_id
attributes.description: Peppol participant identifier of the Supplier (scheme:value).

attributes.name: approval_scope
attributes.description: Scope of the approval per the code list in Section 2.8 of the Rulebook. Mandatory. MAY be selectively disclosable.

attributes.name: approval_valid_from

attributes.name: approval_valid_until
attributes.description: Date until which the approval is valid (business validity, distinct from the technical exp claim). Optional. MAY be selectively disclosable.

attributes.name: approval_reference
attributes.description: Buyer-internal reference for the underlying commercial relationship (e.g. framework agreement number). Optional. MUST be selectively disclosable (SD claim).

attributes.name: status

attributes.name: status/status_purpose

attributes.name: cnf
attributes.description: Confirmation claims per SD-JWT VC. Holder binding via JWK to the Supplier's EBW is recommended.

attributes.name: cnf/jwk
attributes.description: Public key bound to the holder.

credentials.schemaDescription: Schema for the Approved Supplier Attestation encoded as SD-JWT VC, based on the WE BUILD Attestation Rulebook for attestations of type Approved Supplier (Use Case SC5, eInvoicing) and draft-ietf-oauth-sd-jwt-vc

credentials.shortDescription: Natural persons authorised to sign on behalf of a legal entity.

attributes.name: vct
attributes.description: Verifiable Credential Type identifier. SHALL be 'eu.we-build:authorisedsignatories:1'.

attributes.name: iss
attributes.description: Issuer of the attestation. Identifies the legal entity that self-issued the AuthorisedSignatories Attestation. Follows RFC 7519.

attributes.name: iat
attributes.description: Issuance date as a Unix timestamp (seconds since epoch). Represents the date and time when the attestation was issued (ISO 8601 / RFC 7519). SHALL NOT be selectively disclosable.

attributes.name: exp
attributes.description: Expiry date as a Unix timestamp (seconds since epoch). Represents the date and time when the attestation expires (ISO 8601 / RFC 7519). SHALL be later than 'iat'. SHALL NOT be selectively disclosable.

attributes.name: jti
attributes.description: JWT ID — a unique identifier for the attestation token. Follows RFC 7519.

attributes.name: attestation_legal_category
attributes.description: The legal category of the attestation as defined by eIDAS 2. For the AuthorisedSignatories Attestation self-issued by the legal entity, this SHALL be 'EAA'. SHALL NOT be selectively disclosable.

attributes.name: schema_version
attributes.description: Version of the AuthorisedSignatories attestation schema used. SHALL be a non-empty string when present.

attributes.name: legal_entity
attributes.description: Identifies the legal entity that issued the attestation and on whose behalf the authorised persons act. SHALL appear exactly once. SHALL be individually selectively disclosable as a top-level claim.

attributes.name: legal_entity/legal_person
attributes.description: The official legal name and legal form of the entity issuing the attestation.

attributes.name: legal_entity/legal_person/legal_person_name
attributes.description: The complete official legal name of the legal entity.

attributes.name: legal_entity/legal_person/legal_form_type
attributes.description: The legal form of the legal entity (e.g., GmbH, S.A., Ltd, BV).

attributes.name: legal_entity/identifier
attributes.description: Legal identifiers for the entity. The EUID is mandatory; LEI and tax number are optional.

attributes.name: legal_entity/identifier/euid
attributes.description: The European Unique Identifier (EUID) of the legal entity per Directive (EU) 2017/1132. SHALL be a non-empty string.

attributes.name: legal_entity/identifier/lei
attributes.description: Legal Entity Identifier (LEI) per ISO 17442. When present, SHALL be exactly 20 characters.

attributes.name: legal_entity/identifier/tax
attributes.description: National company tax or registration number. Optional.

attributes.name: legal_entity/identifier/gln
attributes.description: Global Location Number for legal entities — GS1 identifier

attributes.name: legal_entity/identifier/duns
attributes.description: Data Universal Numbering System — Dun & Bradstreet identifier

attributes.name: legal_entity/identifier/eori
attributes.description: Economic Operators Registration and Identification number — EU customs identifier

attributes.name: legal_entity/identifier/bpnl
attributes.description: Business Partner Number Legal entity — Catena-X identifier per ICD 0243

attributes.name: legal_entity/identifier/siren
attributes.description: Système d'Identification du Répertoire des ENtreprises — French company identifier

attributes.name: authorised_persons
attributes.description: Array of authorised person objects. SHALL contain at least one entry. Each entry represents a natural person authorised to act on behalf of the legal entity. SHALL be individually selectively disclosable as a top-level claim.

attributes.name: authorised_persons/item/natural_person
attributes.description: Core personal identity attributes of the authorised person. All three fields are mandatory.

attributes.name: authorised_persons/item/natural_person/first_name
attributes.description: The first names in full (including all given names and middle names) of the authorised person.

attributes.name: authorised_persons/item/natural_person/surname
attributes.description: The surnames in full (all family names/last names) of the authorised person.

attributes.name: authorised_persons/item/natural_person/date_of_birth
attributes.description: Day, month, and year of birth of the authorised person per ISO 8601. Format: YYYY-MM-DD.

attributes.name: authorised_persons/item/birth_place
attributes.description: Place of birth of the authorised person. Locality and country are mandatory; region is optional.

attributes.name: authorised_persons/item/birth_place/locality
attributes.description: Locality (city or town) where the natural person was born.

attributes.name: authorised_persons/item/birth_place/country
attributes.description: Country where the natural person was born. SHALL be a valid ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code.

attributes.name: authorised_persons/item/birth_place/region
attributes.description: Optional additional detail on the region or state of birth.

attributes.name: authorised_persons/item/citizenship
attributes.description: Nationality or nationalities of the authorised person. SHALL contain at least one valid ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code.

attributes.name: authorised_persons/item/person_role
attributes.description: Role and representation power of the authorised person within the legal entity. representation_type is mandatory; role is optional.

attributes.name: authorised_persons/item/person_role/representation_type
attributes.description: The nature of the power of representation. SHALL be one of the standardized values defined in Section 2.8.1: 'SOLE' (single signatory has full authority) or 'JOINT' (multiple signatories required).

attributes.name: authorised_persons/item/person_role/role
attributes.description: The role of the authorised person within the company (e.g., CEO, CFO, Director). Optional.

attributes.name: authorised_persons/item/person_role/email
attributes.description: The email of the authorised person . Optional

attributes.name: authorised_persons/item/person_role/phone
attributes.description: The phone of the authorised person . Optional

attributes.name: authorised_persons/item/residence_address
attributes.description: Optional residential address of the authorised person. When present, country SHALL be a valid ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 code.

attributes.name: authorised_persons/item/residence_address/address
attributes.description: The street address where the authorised person currently resides.

attributes.name: authorised_persons/item/residence_address/locality
attributes.description: The city where the authorised person currently resides.

attributes.name: authorised_persons/item/residence_address/postal_code
attributes.description: The postal or ZIP code of the authorised person's address.

attributes.name: authorised_persons/item/residence_address/region
attributes.description: The state, province, or region of the authorised person's address.

attributes.name: authorised_persons/item/residence_address/country
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code where the authorised person resides.

attributes.name: authorised_persons/item/identifier
attributes.description: Optional identity document details for enhanced identification of the authorised person. When present, ALL FOUR fields SHALL be provided together: document_type, document_number, issuing_country, and document_expiry_date.

attributes.name: authorised_persons/item/identifier/document_type
attributes.description: Type of the identity document. SHALL use one of the standardized values defined in Section 2.8.2.

attributes.name: authorised_persons/item/identifier/document_number
attributes.description: The number of the identity document (passport number, national ID number, etc.).

attributes.name: authorised_persons/item/identifier/issuing_country
attributes.description: The country that issued the identity document. SHALL be a valid ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code.

attributes.name: authorised_persons/item/identifier/document_expiry_date
attributes.description: The expiration date of the identity document per ISO 8601. Format: YYYY-MM-DD.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Status object per SD-JWT VC status-list mechanism. MUST be present when the technical validity period (exp - iat) is greater than 24 hours.

attributes.name: status/type
attributes.description: Status mechanism type. For SD-JWT VC Status List this SHALL be 'status-list'.

attributes.name: status/status_list_credential
attributes.description: URI of the Status List Credential that contains the bitstring indicating revocation status.

attributes.name: status/status_list_index
attributes.description: Zero-based index into the status list bitstring for this credential.

attributes.name: status/status_purpose
attributes.description: Purpose of the status entry. For the AuthorisedSignatories Attestation this SHALL be 'revocation'.

attributes.name: trust_anchor_url
attributes.description: URL at which a machine-readable version of the trust anchor used for verifying the AuthorisedSignatories Attestation can be found or looked up. When present, SHALL be a valid URI.

attributes.name: cnf
attributes.description: Confirmation claims per SD-JWT VC. Holder binding via JWK is recommended. The AuthorisedSignatories Attestation SHALL be cryptographically bound to the specific holder wallet.

attributes.name: cnf/jwk
attributes.description: Public key bound to the holder wallet.

attributes.name: cnf/jwk/kty
attributes.description: Key type (e.g., 'EC', 'RSA').

attributes.name: cnf/jwk/crv
attributes.description: Elliptic curve name (e.g., 'P-256'). Required for EC keys.

attributes.name: cnf/jwk/x
attributes.description: X coordinate of the EC public key (Base64url encoded).

attributes.name: cnf/jwk/y
attributes.description: Y coordinate of the EC public key (Base64url encoded).

attributes.name: cnf/jwk/n
attributes.description: RSA modulus (Base64url encoded). Required for RSA keys.

attributes.name: cnf/jwk/e
attributes.description: RSA public exponent (Base64url encoded). Required for RSA keys.

credentials.schemaDescription: Schema for the SD-JWT VC payload of an AuthorisedSignatories Attestation as defined in the AuthorisedSignatories Rulebook (Chapter 3.2). This models the JSON claims set prior to SD-JWT disclosure/packing.

credentials.shortDescription: Mandate for a Peppol access point / service provider to send or receive on behalf of a company (WE BUILD SC5).

attributes.name: vct
attributes.description: Verifiable Credential Type — uniquely identifies the credential type. Always present in plain text. NOT selectively disclosable.

attributes.name: iss
attributes.description: Issuer identifier — a URI identifying the issuer of the credential (the authorising company's issuing system / EBW). As per RFC 7519. NOT selectively disclosable.

attributes.name: iat
attributes.description: Issued At — Unix timestamp (seconds since epoch) indicating when the attestation was issued. NOT selectively disclosable.

attributes.name: exp
attributes.description: Expiration Time — Unix timestamp after which the attestation is no longer valid. NOT selectively disclosable.

attributes.name: nbf
attributes.description: Not Before — Unix timestamp before which the credential MUST NOT be accepted. Optional. NOT selectively disclosable.

attributes.name: sub
attributes.description: Subject — identifier for the subject of the credential (the authorised Service Provider legal entity). Optional. NOT selectively disclosable.

attributes.name: attestation_legal_category
attributes.description: Legal category of this attestation under eIDAS 2. For the Authorized Service Provider attestation this SHALL be 'EAA' (self-issued by the authorising company). NOT selectively disclosable.

attributes.name: schema_version
attributes.description: Version of the Authorized Service Provider attestation schema used. Optional metadata.

attributes.name: trust_anchor_url
attributes.description: URL at which a machine-readable version of the trust anchor used for verifying the attestation can be found or looked up. Optional metadata; for this EAA, trust is anchored in the issuer's EBWOID per Chapter 5 of the Rulebook.

attributes.name: cryptographically_bound_to
attributes.description: vct of the attestation on the same Wallet Unit to which this attestation is cryptographically bound (the Service Provider's EBWOID). RECOMMENDED per ARB_28. NOT selectively disclosable.

attributes.name: authorizing_company
attributes.description: The authorising company (Peppol corner C1 or C4) issuing the mandate. Mandatory. MAY be selectively disclosable.

attributes.name: authorizing_company/legal_name
attributes.description: Registered legal name of the authorising company.

attributes.name: authorizing_company/legal_id
attributes.description: Unique legal-person identifier (EUID) of the company, sourced from its EBWOID.

attributes.name: authorizing_company/peppol_id
attributes.description: Peppol participant identifier of the company (scheme:value).

attributes.name: authorized_service_provider
attributes.description: The Service Provider / Access Point (Peppol corner C2 or C3) being mandated — the holder/subject. Mandatory. MAY be selectively disclosable.

attributes.name: authorized_service_provider/legal_name
attributes.description: Registered legal name of the Service Provider.

attributes.name: authorized_service_provider/legal_id
attributes.description: Unique legal-person identifier (EUID) of the Service Provider.

attributes.name: authorized_service_provider/peppol_ap_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the Service Provider's Peppol Access Point (CN of the AP certificate, e.g. 'POP000123').

attributes.name: authorization_scope
attributes.description: One or more authorised operations per the code list in Section 2.8 of the Rulebook. SHALL contain at least one value. Mandatory. MAY be selectively disclosable.

attributes.name: authorization_valid_from
attributes.description: Date from which the authorization is valid (RFC 3339 full-date). SHALL NOT be later than authorization_valid_until when present. Mandatory. MAY be selectively disclosable.

attributes.name: authorization_valid_until
attributes.description: Date until which the authorization is valid (business validity, distinct from the technical exp claim). Optional. MAY be selectively disclosable.

attributes.name: tax_reporting_member_state
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code of the Member State for which the provider is authorised to perform tax reporting. Conditional: SHALL be present if and only if authorization_scope contains 'vida:tax_report' (integrity rule IR-ASP-02). MAY be selectively disclosable.

attributes.name: authorization_reference
attributes.description: Company-internal reference for the service agreement underlying the mandate. Optional. MUST be selectively disclosable (SD claim).

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Status object per SD-JWT VC status-list mechanism. MUST be present when validity period is greater than 24 hours.

attributes.name: status/type
attributes.description: Status mechanism type. For SD-JWT VC Status List this SHALL be 'status-list'.

attributes.name: status/status_list_credential
attributes.description: URI of the Status List Credential that contains the bitstring indicating revocation status.

attributes.name: status/status_list_index
attributes.description: Zero-based index into the status list bitstring for this credential.

attributes.name: status/status_purpose
attributes.description: Purpose of the status entry. For the Authorized Service Provider attestation this SHALL be 'revocation'.

attributes.name: cnf
attributes.description: Confirmation claims per SD-JWT VC. Holder binding via JWK to the Service Provider's wallet is recommended.

attributes.name: cnf/jwk
attributes.description: Public key bound to the holder.

attributes.name: iat
attributes.description: Issued At — Unix timestamp (seconds since epoch) indicating when the attestation was issued. NOT selectively disclosable.

attributes.name: exp
attributes.description: Expiration Time — Unix timestamp after which the attestation is no longer valid. NOT selectively disclosable.

attributes.name: nbf
attributes.description: Not Before — Unix timestamp before which the credential MUST NOT be accepted. Optional. NOT selectively disclosable.

attributes.name: sub
attributes.description: Subject — identifier for the subject of the credential (the legal entity). NOT selectively disclosable.

attributes.name: issuing_entity
attributes.description: Identifier of the legal entity that issued the attestation. For EAA this is the subject entity. For QEAA this is the QTSP. NOT selectively disclosable.

attributes.name: attestation_legal_category

attributes.name: schema_version
attributes.description: Version of the schema used for this attestation. Optional metadata.

attributes.name: trust_anchor_url

attributes.name: legal_entity
attributes.description: Identifies the legal entity that issued the attestation and on whose behalf the authorised persons act. SHALL appear exactly once. SHALL be individually selectively disclosable as a top-level claim.

attributes.name: legal_entity/legal_person
attributes.description: The official legal name and legal form of the entity issuing the attestation.

attributes.name: legal_entity/legal_person/legal_person_name
attributes.description: The complete official legal name of the legal entity.

attributes.name: legal_entity/legal_person/legal_form_type
attributes.description: The legal form of the legal entity (e.g., GmbH, S.A., Ltd, BV).

attributes.name: legal_entity/identifier

attributes.name: legal_entity/identifier/euid

attributes.name: legal_entity/identifier/siren

attributes.name: number_of_employees
attributes.description: Total number of employees in the legal entity at the time of reporting. SHALL be a non-negative integer. MUST be selectively disclosable (SD claim).

attributes.name: trade_alias
attributes.description: Registered trade names or aliases under which the legal entity operates. MAY contain zero or more text values. Optional. MUST be selectively disclosable.

attributes.name: previous_legal_name

attributes.description: Zero-based index into the status list bitstring for this credential.

attributes.name: financial_statements
attributes.description: Structured financial reporting data following a specified taxonomy. Mandatory. MUST be selectively disclosable as a unit.

attributes.name: financial_statements/taxonomy
attributes.description: Financial reporting standard used to structure and label financial data.

attributes.name: financial_statements/facts
attributes.description: List of reported financial facts. SHALL contain at least one Fact object.

attributes.name: financial_statements/facts/item/id
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the fact within the attestation. SHALL be unique within the facts array.

attributes.name: financial_statements/facts/item/concept
attributes.description: Name of the reported financial metric. SHALL use a standardized concept code from Section 2.8.4.

attributes.name: financial_statements/facts/item/value
attributes.description: Reported numeric value of the fact. SHALL be a non-negative numeric value where applicable.

attributes.name: financial_statements/facts/item/unit
attributes.description: Unit of measurement. When representing a monetary value SHALL follow ISO 4217 (e.g., EUR, USD). Non-monetary: '%' or 'ratio'.

attributes.name: financial_statements/facts/item/period_start
attributes.description: Start date of the reporting period. SHALL be a valid ISO 8601 date (YYYY-MM-DD).

attributes.name: financial_statements/facts/item/period_end
attributes.description: End date of the reporting period. SHALL be a valid ISO 8601 date (YYYY-MM-DD). SHALL be equal to or later than period_start.

credentials.shortDescription: Designated contact persons of a legal entity for trusted organisation-to-organisation exchange.

attributes.name: vct
attributes.description: Verifiable Credential Type identifier. SHALL be 'eu.we-build:contactperson:1'.

attributes.name: iss
attributes.description: Issuer of the attestation. Identifies the legal entity (employing organization) that self-issued the Contact Person Attestation. Follows RFC 7519.

attributes.name: iat
attributes.description: Issuance date as a Unix timestamp (seconds since epoch). Represents the date and time when the attestation was issued per ISO 8601 / RFC 7519. SHALL NOT be selectively disclosable.

attributes.name: exp
attributes.description: Expiry date as a Unix timestamp (seconds since epoch). Represents the date and time when the attestation expires per ISO 8601 / RFC 7519. SHALL be later than 'iat'. SHALL NOT be selectively disclosable.

attributes.name: issuing_entity
attributes.description: The identifier of the legal entity that issued the attestation. Typically a DID or other resolvable identifier of the employing organization. SHALL NOT be selectively disclosable.

attributes.name: attestation_legal_category
attributes.description: The legal category of the attestation as defined by eIDAS 2. For the Contact Person Attestation self-issued by the employing legal entity, this SHALL be 'EAA'. SHALL NOT be selectively disclosable.

attributes.name: schema_version
attributes.description: Version of the Contact Person attestation schema used. SHALL be a non-empty string when present.

attributes.name: trust_anchor_url
attributes.description: URL at which a machine-readable version of the trust anchor used for verifying the Contact Person Attestation can be found or looked up. When present, SHALL be a valid URI.

attributes.name: contact_persons
attributes.description: Array of contact person objects. SHALL contain at least one entry. Each entry represents a distinct natural person designated as a contact within the legal entity. The array itself SHALL be selectively disclosable as a top-level claim; individual objects within the array MAY also be individually disclosed.

attributes.name: contact_persons/item/given_name
attributes.description: Given name of the contact person. In the U.S., the first name of a Person. Per Schema.org givenName. SHALL be a non-empty string.

attributes.name: contact_persons/item/family_name
attributes.description: Family name of the contact person. In the U.S., the last name of a Person. Per Schema.org familyName. SHALL be a non-empty string.

attributes.name: contact_persons/item/role
attributes.description: Role of the contact person within the organization, denoting their function or responsibility (e.g., sales, finance, quality, logistics). Per the W3C Organization Ontology. SHALL be a non-empty string. SHOULD use values from Section 2.8.2.

attributes.name: contact_persons/item/email
attributes.description: Electronic address through which the Contact Person can be contacted. SHALL be a valid email address conforming to RFC 4021. Per CPOV contact point vocabulary.

attributes.name: contact_persons/item/telephone
attributes.description: Telephone number through which the Contact Person can be contacted. When present, SHALL conform to ITU-T E.164 international public telecommunication numbering plan, including the country code prefix (e.g., +49123456789). Per CPOV contact point vocabulary. Optional.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Status object per SD-JWT VC status-list mechanism. MUST be present when the technical validity period (exp - iat) is greater than 24 hours. Enables Relying Parties to check revocation status of the credential.

attributes.name: status/type
attributes.description: Status mechanism type. For SD-JWT VC Status List this SHALL be 'status-list'.

attributes.name: status/status_list_credential
attributes.description: URI of the Status List Credential document that contains the bitstring indicating revocation status.

attributes.name: status/status_list_index
attributes.description: Zero-based index into the status list bitstring that corresponds to this credential.

attributes.name: status/status_purpose
attributes.description: Purpose of the status entry. For the Contact Person Attestation this SHALL be 'revocation'.

attributes.name: cnf
attributes.description: Confirmation claims per SD-JWT VC. Holder binding via JWK is recommended. The Contact Person Attestation SHALL be cryptographically bound to the specific holder wallet of the employing organization.

attributes.name: cnf/jwk
attributes.description: Public key bound to the holder wallet.

attributes.name: cnf/jwk/kty
attributes.description: Key type (e.g., 'EC', 'RSA').

attributes.name: cnf/jwk/crv
attributes.description: Elliptic curve name (e.g., 'P-256'). Required for EC keys.

attributes.name: cnf/jwk/x
attributes.description: X coordinate of the EC public key (Base64url encoded).

attributes.name: cnf/jwk/y
attributes.description: Y coordinate of the EC public key (Base64url encoded).

attributes.name: cnf/jwk/n
attributes.description: RSA modulus (Base64url encoded). Required for RSA keys.

attributes.name: cnf/jwk/e

attributes.name: legal_entity

attributes.name: legal_entity/legal_person
attributes.description: The official legal name and legal form of the entity issuing the attestation.

attributes.name: legal_entity/legal_person/legal_person_name

attributes.name: legal_entity/legal_person/legal_form_type

credentials.shortDescription: Dataspace or DSI membership, roles and accepted governance rulebook for seamless onboarding (WE BUILD SC2).

attributes.name: iss
attributes.description: Issuer identifier. For the SD-JWT VC profile this is normally the onboarding service provider HTTPS URL.

attributes.name: iat
attributes.description: Issued-at timestamp as a JWT NumericDate.

attributes.name: nbf
attributes.description: Not-before timestamp as a JWT NumericDate, where used.

attributes.name: exp
attributes.description: Expiration timestamp as a JWT NumericDate.

attributes.name: jti
attributes.description: Unique credential instance identifier.

attributes.name: vct
attributes.description: Verifiable Credential Type for the Membership Credential.

attributes.name: attestation_legal_category
attributes.description: Legal category of the attestation. In EBWV v0.1, EAA denotes the non-qualified Electronic Attestation of Attributes category.

attributes.name: id
attributes.description: DID of the credential subject. May change, in contrast to member.legalIdentifier. DS-specific name retained for interoperability.

attributes.name: member
attributes.description: The holder of the credential, as an economic operator. member.legalIdentifier carries the stable, EU-level identifier; for the MVP this re-uses the EUID from the holder's EUBWOID. DS-specific name retained for interoperability.

attributes.name: member/legalName
attributes.description: Official legal name of the economic operator.

attributes.name: member/legalIdentifier
attributes.description: The stable, EU-level identifier. Scheme is Euid or PublicSectorBodyId (range of the legalIdentifier property). Used by member.

attributes.name: member/legalIdentifier/scheme
attributes.description: Identifier scheme, published as a named individual by the European Business Wallet Vocabulary. See Rulebook code list 2.8.

attributes.name: member/legalIdentifier/value
attributes.description: The identifier value, in the scheme given by scheme.

attributes.name: member/identifier
attributes.description: A further identifier of the economic operator, in any scheme from code list 2.8. Used by onboardedBy.operator.

attributes.name: member/identifier/scheme
attributes.description: Identifier scheme, published as a named individual by the European Business Wallet Vocabulary. See Rulebook code list 2.8.

attributes.name: member/identifier/value
attributes.description: The identifier value, in the scheme given by scheme.

attributes.name: memberOf
attributes.description: DSI or dataspace membership value. An absolute IRI registered in Rulebook code list 2.8, under the owning DSI's or dataspace's own domain. The memberOf property is typed @id in the European Business Wallet Vocabulary, so the value is an IRI and not a plain label.

attributes.name: holderIdentifier
attributes.description: Stable and unique identifier used within the DSI or dataspace to refer to THE HOLDER. Populated only where it differs from member.legalIdentifier. Subject to integrity rules IR-06 and IR-07.

attributes.name: role
attributes.description: The roles the holder has within the DSI or dataspace. Each value is an absolute IRI; those registered in Rulebook code list 2.8 are the DataSpaceRole individuals under https://w3id.org/ebwv#. A DSI may mint further role IRIs under a namespace it owns. A single role may appear as a scalar rather than a one-element array; both forms are accepted. See Rulebook Section 3.3.1.

attributes.name: termsOfUse
attributes.description: Dataspace governance rulebook information. See Rulebook Section 2.2.1.

attributes.name: termsOfUse/url
attributes.description: Reference to the online dataspace governance rulebook.

attributes.name: termsOfUse/version
attributes.description: Version of the online rulebook at the time of acceptance.

attributes.name: termsOfUse/hash
attributes.description: SHA-256 hash of the rulebook, represented as 64 hexadecimal characters.

attributes.name: termsOfUse/acceptedAt
attributes.description: Datetime when the rulebook was accepted, where present. Subject to integrity rule IR-01.

attributes.name: onboardedBy
attributes.description: The platform through which the holder was onboarded: the platform itself and the economic operator hosting it. Describes the onboarding party only; how the holder was identified is recorded in evidence. See Rulebook Section 2.2.2.

attributes.name: onboardedBy/platformId
attributes.description: DID identifying the platform through which the holder was onboarded.

attributes.name: onboardedBy/name
attributes.description: Commercial name of the platform (DSI or onboarding partner).

attributes.name: onboardedBy/operator
attributes.description: The economic operator hosting and running the platform. Its identifier identifies that organisation, NOT the holder.

attributes.name: onboardedBy/operator/legalName
attributes.description: Official legal name of the economic operator.

attributes.name: onboardedBy/operator/legalIdentifier
attributes.description: The stable, EU-level identifier. Scheme is Euid or PublicSectorBodyId (range of the legalIdentifier property). Used by member.

attributes.name: onboardedBy/operator/legalIdentifier/scheme
attributes.description: Identifier scheme, published as a named individual by the European Business Wallet Vocabulary. See Rulebook code list 2.8.

attributes.name: onboardedBy/operator/legalIdentifier/value
attributes.description: The identifier value, in the scheme given by scheme.

attributes.name: onboardedBy/operator/identifier
attributes.description: A further identifier of the economic operator, in any scheme from code list 2.8. Used by onboardedBy.operator.

attributes.name: onboardedBy/operator/identifier/scheme
attributes.description: Identifier scheme, published as a named individual by the European Business Wallet Vocabulary. See Rulebook code list 2.8.

attributes.name: onboardedBy/operator/identifier/value
attributes.description: The identifier value, in the scheme given by scheme.

attributes.name: evidence
attributes.description: The identification means used to prove the holder's identity during the initial onboarding process. Describes the HOLDER, never the platform or its operator. Subject to integrity rules IR-03 and IR-04. A single entry may appear as an object rather than a one-element array; both forms are accepted. See Rulebook Sections 2.6.1 and 3.3.1.

attributes.name: evidence/identifier
attributes.description: The identifier by which the holder's identity was proven during onboarding.

attributes.name: evidence/identifier/scheme
attributes.description: Identifier scheme, published as a named individual by the European Business Wallet Vocabulary. See Rulebook code list 2.8.

attributes.name: evidence/identifier/value
attributes.description: The identifier value, in the scheme given by scheme.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Status-list revocation information.

attributes.name: status/type
attributes.description: Status mechanism type.

attributes.name: status/status_list_credential
attributes.description: URI of the Status List Credential that contains the status bitstring.

attributes.name: status/status_list_index
attributes.description: Zero-based index into the status list bitstring for this credential.

attributes.name: status/status_purpose
attributes.description: Purpose of the status entry.

attributes.name: cnf
attributes.description: Confirmation claims per SD-JWT VC. Used when the credential is holder-bound.

attributes.name: cnf/jwk
attributes.description: Public key bound to the holder.

attributes.name: schema_version

attributes.name: trust_anchor_url
attributes.description: URL of the trust anchor.

attributes.name: duns_number
attributes.description: Nine-digit unique identifier from Dun & Bradstreet.

attributes.name: legal_entity
attributes.description: Object encapsulating the legal identity of the entity.

attributes.name: legal_entity/legal_name
attributes.description: Registered legal name of the entity.

attributes.name: legal_entity/legal_form
attributes.description: Legal form of the entity.

attributes.name: legal_entity/address
attributes.description: The official registered address of the entity.

attributes.name: legal_entity/address/street

attributes.name: legal_entity/address/nr

attributes.name: legal_entity/address/postal_code
attributes.description: Postal or ZIP code.

attributes.name: legal_entity/address/city

attributes.name: legal_entity/address/country
attributes.description: Country (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2).

attributes.name: status

attributes.name: cnf
attributes.description: Confirmation claims for holder binding.

attributes.name: id

attributes.name: name

attributes.name: attestation_legal_category
attributes.description: The legal category of the attestation.

attributes.name: date_of_expiry
attributes.description: Administrative expiry date following ISO 8601.

attributes.name: issuing_authority

attributes.name: issuing_country

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Status object per SD-JWT VC status-list mechanism (required when validity > 24h).

attributes.name: status/type
attributes.description: Status mechanism type. For SD-JWT VC Status List this SHALL be 'status-list'.

attributes.name: status/status_list_credential
attributes.description: URI of the Status List Credential that contains the bitstring indicating status.

attributes.name: status/status_purpose

credentials.shortDescription: SD-JWT VC claims set bound to an EN 16931 / Peppol eInvoice payload (WE BUILD SC5).

attributes.name: vct
attributes.description: Verifiable Credential Type identifier. Section 2.5 / 3.2.

attributes.name: iss
attributes.description: Issuer identifier (the Supplier's issuing system / EBW). Section 2.5.

attributes.name: iat
attributes.description: Issuance timestamp (NumericDate). Section 2.5.

attributes.name: exp
attributes.description: Technical expiry timestamp of the attestation (NumericDate). Section 2.5.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Token Status List reference for revocation (metadata, distinct from the business `status` attribute below). Section 2.5 / Chapter 6.

attributes.name: status/status_list/idx
attributes.description: status_list_index: zero-based index into the status list bitstring.

attributes.name: status/status_list/uri
attributes.description: status_list_credential: URI of the Status List Credential.

attributes.name: cnf
attributes.description: Holder key-binding confirmation (proof of possession by the Supplier's EBW at issuance). Section 2.5.

attributes.name: cnf/jwk
attributes.description: JSON Web Key of the holder (Supplier's EBW).

attributes.name: cryptographically_bound_to
attributes.description: vct of the Supplier's EBWOID attestation on the same Wallet Unit to which this attestation is bound. RECOMMENDED. Section 2.6 / Chapter 4.

attributes.name: attestation_legal_category
attributes.description: Legal category of the attestation. For this rulebook profile the exact value SHALL be `non-qualified-EAA`. Section 2.1.

attributes.name: invoicePayloadHash
attributes.description: Hash of the canonicalized invoice payload; binds the attestation to the external EN 16931 / Peppol BIS invoice (IR-EI-03). Section 2.2. NOTE: canonicalization method and hash algorithm are OPEN pending WP4 confirmation; sha256 assumed here.

attributes.name: invoiceFormat
attributes.description: Identifier of the invoice representation/profile used for the payload. Code list, Section 2.8.

attributes.name: invoiceNumber
attributes.description: EN 16931 BT-1. Invoice identifier, unique for the Supplier within the duplicate-detection window (IR-EI-04). Section 2.2.

attributes.name: issueDate
attributes.description: EN 16931 BT-2. Invoice issue date (RFC 3339 full-date). Section 2.2.

attributes.name: seller
attributes.description: The Supplier (issuer). Mandatory. v0.8: replaces the flat seller* claims.

attributes.name: seller/name
attributes.description: EN 16931 BT-27 (seller)/BT-44 (buyer). Registered legal name.

attributes.name: seller/identifier
attributes.description: Legal-entity identifiers; at least euid SHALL be present.

attributes.name: seller/identifier/euid
attributes.description: European Unique Identifier. Verified (IR-EI-06).

attributes.name: seller/identifier/lei
attributes.description: Legal Entity Identifier, ISO 17442. Unverified.

attributes.name: seller/identifier/tax
attributes.description: National tax/registration number. Unverified.

attributes.name: seller/identifier/gln
attributes.description: GS1 Global Location Number. Unverified.

attributes.name: seller/identifier/duns
attributes.description: Dun & Bradstreet DUNS. Unverified.

attributes.name: seller/identifier/eori
attributes.description: EU customs identifier. Unverified.

attributes.name: seller/identifier/bpnl
attributes.description: Catena-X Business Partner Number Legal, ICD 0243. Unverified.

attributes.name: seller/identifier/siren
attributes.description: French national company identifier. Unverified.

attributes.name: seller/vat
attributes.description: EN 16931 BT-31 (seller)/BT-48 (buyer). VAT/tax registration identifier.

attributes.name: seller/country
attributes.description: EN 16931 BT-40 (seller)/BT-55 (buyer). ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code.

attributes.name: buyer
attributes.description: The Buyer (relying party). Optional as a whole; if present, all members SHALL be present. v0.8: replaces the flat buyer* claims.

attributes.name: buyer/name
attributes.description: EN 16931 BT-27 (seller)/BT-44 (buyer). Registered legal name.

attributes.name: buyer/identifier
attributes.description: Legal-entity identifiers; at least euid SHALL be present.

attributes.name: buyer/identifier/euid
attributes.description: European Unique Identifier. Verified (IR-EI-06).

attributes.name: buyer/identifier/lei
attributes.description: Legal Entity Identifier, ISO 17442. Unverified.

attributes.name: buyer/identifier/tax
attributes.description: National tax/registration number. Unverified.

attributes.name: buyer/identifier/gln
attributes.description: GS1 Global Location Number. Unverified.

attributes.name: buyer/identifier/duns
attributes.description: Dun & Bradstreet DUNS. Unverified.

attributes.name: buyer/identifier/eori
attributes.description: EU customs identifier. Unverified.

attributes.name: buyer/identifier/bpnl
attributes.description: Catena-X Business Partner Number Legal, ICD 0243. Unverified.

attributes.name: buyer/identifier/siren
attributes.description: French national company identifier. Unverified.

attributes.name: buyer/vat
attributes.description: EN 16931 BT-31 (seller)/BT-48 (buyer). VAT/tax registration identifier.

attributes.name: buyer/country
attributes.description: EN 16931 BT-40 (seller)/BT-55 (buyer). ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code.

attributes.name: BuyerElectronicAddress
attributes.description: EN 16931 BT-49. Address/endpoint identifier for delivery/receipt handling. Section 2.3.

attributes.name: amountDueForPayment
attributes.description: EN 16931 BT-115. Total payable amount. Section 2.2.

attributes.name: invoiceTotalVatAmount
attributes.description: EN 16931 BT-110. Total VAT amount for this invoice; SHALL equal the sum of taxSubtotal.taxAmount when taxSubtotal is present (IR-EI-07). Section 2.2.

attributes.name: InvoiceCurrencyCode
attributes.description: EN 16931 BT-5. ISO 4217 invoice currency code. Section 2.2.

attributes.name: taxSubtotal
attributes.description: EN 16931 BG-23. VAT breakdown, one entry per tax category/rate. Section 2.3/2.4.

attributes.name: taxSubtotal/item/taxCategoryCode
attributes.description: EN 16931 BT-118 / UNCL 5305 VAT category code (EN 16931-aligned subset). Section 2.8.

attributes.name: taxSubtotal/item/taxableAmount
attributes.description: EN 16931 BT-116. Sum of net amounts for this VAT category/rate.

attributes.name: taxSubtotal/item/taxPercent
attributes.description: EN 16931 BT-119. VAT percentage rate.

attributes.name: taxSubtotal/item/taxAmount
attributes.description: EN 16931 BT-117. Total VAT calculated for this subtotal.

attributes.name: taxSubtotal/item/taxExemptionReasonCode
attributes.description: EN 16931 BT-121. Standardized VAT exemption reason code (optional within group).

attributes.name: paymentInstructions
attributes.description: EN 16931 BG-16. Payment-related information. Contains sensitive payment data; issuer MUST make selectively disclosable. Section 2.3/2.4/3.2.

attributes.name: paymentInstructions/paymentMeansCode
attributes.description: EN 16931 BT-81 / UNCL 4461. 30=Credit transfer, 48=Bank card, 49=Direct debit, 58=SEPA credit transfer. Section 2.8.

attributes.name: paymentInstructions/paymentMeansText
attributes.description: EN 16931 BT-82. Text description of the payment method (optional within group).

attributes.name: paymentInstructions/paymentAccountIdentifier
attributes.description: EN 16931 BT-84. Payment account identifier (IBAN or other bank account number).

attributes.name: paymentInstructions/paymentCardPAN
attributes.description: EN 16931 BT-87. Payment card PAN, masked or full (optional within group).

attributes.name: evidenceReferences
attributes.description: References to supporting evidence items (e.g. purchase order, delivery note). Section 2.3/2.4.

attributes.name: evidenceReferences/item/evidenceReferencesType
attributes.description: Type of the referenced supporting evidence item. Section 2.8.

attributes.name: evidenceReferences/item/evidenceUri
attributes.description: Publicly accessible URI of the evidence item (must be public; no protected-URI auth mechanism is standardized). Section 2.8.

attributes.name: evidenceReferences/item/evidenceHash
attributes.description: Hash of the evidence item referenced by evidenceUri, for integrity binding (IR-EI-08).

attributes.name: invoiceLifecycleStatus
attributes.description: Business lifecycle status for corrections, cancellations and credit notes. If omitted, the lifecycle status SHALL be interpreted as `active`. Distinct from the registered `status` metadata claim used for Token Status List revocation. Sections 2.3, 2.8 and IR-EI-09.

attributes.name: precedingInvoiceReference
attributes.description: EN 16931 BT-25. Identifier of the original or preceding invoice. SHALL be present when invoiceLifecycleStatus is corrected, cancelled or credited; MAY be omitted when the lifecycle status is active or omitted. Section 2.4 and IR-EI-09.

attributes.name: company_kind_of_legal_entity

attributes.name: company_jurisdiction

attributes.name: company_registered_office

attributes.name: attorney_full_name

attributes.name: attorney_date_of_birth
attributes.description: Date of birth of the attorney (ISO 8601, YYYY-MM-DD).

attributes.name: attorney_identification_document_kind
attributes.description: Type of identification document presented by the attorney. See code list in rulebook section 2.8.

attributes.name: attorney_identification_document_number

credentials.schemaDescription: The VAT-ID attestation is an official document issued by a recognized authority, such as the Tax Administration, that verifies the validity of a VAT-ID. This attestation serves as proof of the company’s or administrative unit’s VAT-ID and its corresponding validity period. It contains only information directly related to the VAT-ID. The VAT-ID attestation can be utilized by a company to substantiate its identity and ownership of the provided VAT-ID. The recipient of the attestation can trust its authenticity, eliminating the need for external verification through the VAT Information Exchange System (VIES) or the request for a physical VAT-ID Certificate.

Verifiable digital credential defined by EMVCo for secure and interoperable card-based payment authentication using digital wallets.
Digital till receipt issued to a customer's EUDI Wallet after payment (WE BUILD rb-e-receipt v2.0).
Verifiable ESG certificates of a legal entity for KYS, onboarding and audit.
EWC WP3 EU Company Certificate as used in the WE BUILD catalog (vct urn:eudi:eucc:1).
Power of attorney granting an attorney six company-law representation powers on behalf of a legal entity (WE BUILD ds007).
EUDI VAT identification attestation as published in the WE BUILD catalog (vct uri:eu.eudi.vat.1).
Proof of enrollment into a specific exam (eduwallet proeftuin). Attribute schema pending publication by the pilot.
Credential issued after Gaia-X compliance checks for a participant or offering.
Credential describing a data resource in Gaia-X.
Credential describing a legal participant in the Gaia-X ecosystem.
Credential expressing a legal registration reference for a Gaia-X participant.
Credential describing a physical resource in Gaia-X.

A secure digital ID based on passport information that can be saved in Google Wallet and used to verify identity or age for in-person and online services.
EUDI Wallet Health ID attestation. Available as ISO mDoc and SD-JWT VC.
EUDI Wallet credential for an International Bank Account Number (IBAN). Available as ISO mDoc and SD-JWT VC.
IBAN-OV attestation that a legal entity owns a given IBAN.

Personal details derived from an ICAO machine-readable ID card and issued as a Yivi Idemix credential by the Privacy by Design Foundation. Includes name, document data, nationality, age-over flags, EU citizenship, and an optional portrait.
Trade document evidencing insurance coverage for goods or shipment.

ISO 9001-style quality management certification (demo). Issued by an accredited certification body under the ISO Certification (demo) registry of the Verana Playground and published on the certified organization's DID as a Linked Verifiable Presentation; anyone verifies it free of charge through trust resolution. For demonstration only; not affiliated with ISO.

Proof of legal representation issued by the National Business Registry of the Republic of Verandia (demo): who may act on behalf of a registered company, and with which powers. Issuance is sovereign (the register is the single source of truth); verification is open and free so the whole economy can rely on it. Part of the Verana Playground; for demonstration only.
Dataspace or DSI membership, roles and accepted governance rulebook for seamless onboarding (WE BUILD SC2).
Mobile phone number (MSISDN) attestation used to prove control over a phone number for authentication and communication. Available as ISO mDoc and SD-JWT VC.
Open Badges v3 microcredential (edubadge) as offered in the eduwallet proeftuin. Attribute schema pending publication by the pilot.
An AP2 credential that defines the conditions under which an agent is authorized to negotiate and construct a checkout on behalf of a user or organization.

An AP2 credential that authorizes an agent to make a payment on behalf of the user within predefined constraints. A Closed Payment Mandate can subsequently be created for a specific payment that complies with these constraints.
Direct and indirect ownership interests in a legal entity (persons, entities and arrangements).
Trade document listing packaged goods, quantities, and packaging details.

Personal details derived from an ICAO machine-readable passport and issued as a Yivi Idemix credential by the Privacy by Design Foundation. Includes name, document data, nationality, age-over flags, EU citizenship, and an optional portrait.

The Payment Account credential is a SCA (Strong Customer Authentication) Attestation issued by a PSP into a Wallet Unit that serves as a verifiable digital proof that the Wallet Unit is associated with a specific Payer and, if applicable, their account managed by the PSP.

The Payment Card credential is a SCA (Strong Customer Authentication) Attestation issued by a PSP into a Wallet Unit that serves as a verifiable digital proof that the Wallet Unit is associated with a specific Payer and, if applicable, their card managed by the PSP.
Negotiated payment terms of a legal entity, for KYS and invoicing flows.
Proves an employee remains covered by their home country’s social security system when working across borders (EU PDA1). Available as ISO mDoc and SD-JWT VC.
ISO/IEC TS 23220-4 Photo ID. The doctype is org.iso.23220.photoid.1. Issuers that still publish org.iso.23220.2.photoid.1 resolve to this same type.
Person Identification Data (PID) for the EU Digital Identity Wallet. Available as ISO mDoc and SD-JWT VC.

EUDI Wallet Power of Representation attestation. Available as ISO mDoc and SD-JWT VC.
Trade document used by a buyer to place an order with a seller.
Physical or operational site of a legal entity.
Digital institutional / college card (eduwallet proeftuin). Attribute schema pending publication by the pilot.
Data about the study and courses followed (eduwallet proeftuin). Attribute schema pending publication by the pilot.
Accessibility/support entitlement, e.g. extra exam time (eduwallet proeftuin). Attribute schema pending publication by the pilot.
EUDI Wallet Tax Number attestation. Available as ISO mDoc and SD-JWT VC.
Natural persons who ultimately own or control a legal entity (AMLR 2024/1624).

The national identity credential of the Republic of Verandia (demo), a fictional e-government scenario of the Verana Playground. Issued solely by the National Civil Registry with eIDAS-2-PID-inspired claims; verification is governed too: only registered relying parties hold a VERIFIER permission, and compliant wallets refuse requests from anyone else before any attribute leaves the device. For demonstration only.
Credential expressing a context-specific role in a business engagement, for example supplier, buyer, customer, contractor, consignee, or auditor in a specific transaction or relationship.
Credential issued by a Qualified vLEI Issuer to a legal entity, based on its globally unique Legal Entity Identifier (LEI), providing a verifiable digital representation of the organization.
Credential linking a person to an official role within a legal entity, for example CEO, director, board member, secretary, or other formally recognized organizational role.
Credential issued by GLEIF to an officially recognized Qualified vLEI Issuer, such as an organization authorized to issue vLEI credentials to legal entities and their representatives.
A credential issued by a Legal Entity to a Qualified vLEI Issuer (QVI), authorizing it to issue Engagement Context Role (ECR) credentials to individuals on behalf of that legal entity.
A credential issued by a Legal Entity to a Qualified vLEI Issuer (QVI), authorizing it to issue Official Organizational Role (OOR) credentials to individuals on behalf of that legal entity.
Trade document acknowledging storage of goods in a warehouse.
